messages:
liz: quick design check — putting the SSO preference toggle next to the role tiles on the org landing. mock attached in Figma. feels right for discoverability but worried about visual clutter and screenreader order.
raj: can you paste the mock? i can't open figma from phone.
liz: pasted a tiny screenshot, but main point: two-column tile grid, each tile has role name, member count, primary CTA (Invite) and a small SSO toggle icon (eye/lock).
noah: hmm i worry about keyboard focus. if the toggle is inside the tile it may not be first tabbable thing — Invite CTA should probably be first. also screenreader will read visual order which could confuse people who expect role name -> actions.
emma: agree with noah. also contrast on the toggle icon is < 3:1 on gray background per a11y-bot scan. we need higher contrast and an accessible label.
a11y-bot: automated scan results:
```
- element .role-tile .sso-toggle: contrast ratio 2.6:1
- missing aria-label on SSO toggle
- focus order: clickable tile content precedes toggle in DOM but not visually
```
liz: thanks — proposed fixes: 1) move SSO toggle to a dedicated actions column (rightmost) so visual and DOM order match. 2) make Invite button primary and first tabbable. 3) update toggle to an explicit labelled switch (text: "SSO required") with aria-checked.
raj: I like explicit text. toggles without text are easy to miss. but worried about horizontal real-estate on small screens. can we collapse to an overflow menu on narrow widths?
liz: yes — suggestion: mobile: keep Invite + kebab menu; inside menu have "Require SSO" switch with aria role="menuitemcheckbox" and screenreader-only label. desktop: full actions visible.
noah: implementation nit: if we move the toggle into an actions column, we should avoid adding a new grid column — maybe use CSS flex on the tile to push actions to end. ensures consistent focus order.
emma: copy suggestion for the switch label: instead of "Require SSO" use "Enforce SSO for this role" — clearer but longer. shorter label could be "SSO enforced" as on/off. which do we prefer?
liz: prefer shorter for UI but expand for screenreaders: visible label "SSO enforced", aria-label="Enforce single sign-on for members of this role".
raj: quick UX question: what happens when someone toggles SSO on for a role that currently has users without SSO? we need a confirmation modal that lists affected members and consequence (they won't be able to sign in until they enable SSO). also add a link to audit log entry.
liz: good call. modal copy draft: "Turning on SSO for Admins will prevent members without SSO set up from signing in. Affected users: 3. Proceed?" with a link "View affected users" and checkbox "I understand".
a11y-bot: modal a11y checks to run: focus trap, initial focus on primary action, escape closes, descriptive heading, roles in list have accessible names.
noah: one more thought — the Invite CTA text currently "Invite" vs "Invite to role". small change but reduces ambiguity when there are many actions. propose change to "Invite to role" on desktop and "Invite" on mobile.
emma: also add tooltip on hover for SSO label: "Requires single sign-on for all members of this role." tooltips must be accessible: appear on focus and hover.
liz: ok action items: 1) design update with actions column and labeled switch (i'll post new mock by EOD). 2) product to write modal copy and audit link text (raj). 3) eng to validate focus order and keyboard nav (noah). 4) a11y checklist run after proto (emma/a11y-bot).
raj: fine. small vote: +1 for explicit text label, -0 for modal confirmation.
noah: +1 for moving toggle to actions and focus-first Invite.
emma: +1 for copy changes and tooltip accessibility.
a11y-bot: noting: schedule re-scan after new mock uploaded.
liz: thanks team — i'll update Figma and ping here when done. :thumbsup:
